remarks: Beautiful 2 Bedroom Apartment | Heat & Hot Water Included | Norwalk, CT 06851.  Convenient to everything! This beautiful 2-bedroom, 1-bath second-floor corner apartment is located in a well-maintained brick building in the heart of Norwalk.  The unit features oversized windows that provide great natural light and hardwood floors throughout. The updated kitchen offers custom-built cabinetry, Corian countertops, and stainless steel appliances, including a dishwasher, along with plenty of storage space.  The building itself has been tastefully updated, with hardwood flooring and crown molding in the hallways, adding to its charm and quality feel.  Prime central location close to shopping, restaurants, entertainment, and public transportation.  Bonus:  Heat and hot water included in rent  A comfortable, stylish apartment in a convenient location-don't miss this opportunity!
